parameters.toolDescription: Get the writing and publishing rules for every platform: facebook, instagram, threads, linkedin, x, reddit, facebook_group. Returns max_chars, max_hashtags, max_title_chars, media_required, allowed_media, link_policy, tone_guide and format_notes. ALWAYS call this before writing platform versions of a post.
List the user's saved Facebook groups and subreddits (id, platform, name, url, subreddit, flair, rules_notes). Use the id values as group_target_ids when drafting reddit or facebook_group variants.

parameters.toolDescription: Save a new post as a DRAFT with one version per platform. Nothing is published. The user reviews and publishes in the dashboard. Call get_platform_rules first and write each version to fit its platform. Count characters carefully; hashtags are appended to the body automatically, do not also put them in body. payload JSON shape: {"title": short internal title, "master_text": the full original content (required), "topic": short topic, "content_type": one of tip, story, announcement, promo, question, case_study, opinion, news, "tags": [internal tags], "source": "claude" or "manual" (manual when the user wrote the text), "media": [{"public_url": "https://...", "mime_type": "image/jpeg"}] optional, only real public URLs the user gave. The first image is attached to facebook, instagram, threads and linkedin (one click publish supports 1 image, no video), "variants": [{"platform": facebook|instagram|threads|linkedin|x|reddit|facebook_group, "body": text without hashtags, "hashtags": ["tag"], "link_url": optional, "title": required for reddit, "group_target_ids": [ids] for reddit and facebook_group, "use_media": true or false}]}. Returns post_id and each variant with char_count, max_chars and errors. If any variant has errors, fix it with update_variant. Instagram errors about missing media are fine: the user uploads media in the dashboard.

parameters.toolDescription: Get analytics for published posts: totals by platform, engagement by content type, by posting hour (Pakistan time), top 10 and worst 5 posts with their opening text. Use it to suggest what to post next.

parameters.content:
## Claude MCP Server
Claude can read rules, create and edit DRAFTS, and read analytics.
Claude can NOT publish. Publishing only happens from the dashboard.

Connect in Claude: Settings > Connectors > Add custom connector > paste the Production URL of the MCP Server node.
Keep the URL private: the random path is the key.
